name_story.story: Salem can be understood through the Arabic form سَالِم, whose central sense is salem; safe, sound. Salem is Arabic سَالِم (Sālim), the active participle of سَلِمَ, meaning 'safe, sound'.

faq.a: Salem is associated with the Arabic form سَالِم, whose core sense is salem; safe, sound.

faq.q: What is the origin of Salem?
faq.a: Salem is associated with Arabic. Salem is Arabic سَالِم (Sālim), the active participle of سَلِمَ, meaning 'safe, sound'.
Yes — the underlying form سَالِم is Arabic.
Salem can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Salem should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root س ل م is Quranic, but Sālim is not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Salem mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Salem is rendered سالم and carries the sense سالم، محفوظ.

faq.q: What does Salem mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Salem is rendered سالم and carries the sense سالم، بی‌گزند.
A romanized syllable approximation is sa-lem. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Salem?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Salem, salem. Script forms are سالم, سَالِم, सालेम.

faq.q: Is Salem a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
